summary: This directory provides a centralized set of utility functions for normalizing, resolving, and transforming file system paths within the project structure, ensuring consistent path handling across build and module resolution processes.
responsibilities: Resolving project-relative and absolute file paths
Mapping between source files and their corresponding output files
Translating module specifiers to actual file system locations
Identifying the root directory of the workspace
relationships: Path transformation functions rely on workspace identification to define the project scope for absolute and relative paths.
Mapping functions translate between source and output paths to bridge the gap between development files and compiled artifacts.
Module specifier mappings utilize path resolution logic to translate logical imports into physical source paths.
designDecisions: Consolidation of path logic in a shared location to prevent duplication across build tooling
Encapsulation of file system operations to simplify path manipulation logic
Consistent usage of absolute and project-relative paths to ensure environment-agnostic behavior
